_meta.what: Thai names players use for monsters and items. Used for on-site search, and shown on the entity page as 'เรียกอีกชื่อ'.
_meta.rule: Every entry must come from a search someone really ran, not from translating a name. `source` says which log it came from: `gsc` carries the impressions and the position Google put us at, `site-search` carries how many times it was typed into the site's own box (GA4, which has no position to report). Two kinds of name appear: a Thai spelling of the English name (คาราเมล for Caramel) and a nickname for what the thing looks like or does (หมาฟ้า, 'blue dog', for Wolf; การ์ดเทเลพอต, 'teleport card', for Creamy Card, which grants Teleport).
_meta.source: Google Search Console, sc-domain:rozerothai.com. First round: 90 days to 7 Sep 2026. Second round: 90 days to 23 Sep 2026. Each pair is a query whose Thai text Google itself matched to that page. · บางคำมาจากช่องค้นในเว็บเอง (GA4 event search) ซึ่งบอกได้ว่าคนพิมพ์อะไรแล้วไม่เจอ
_meta.regenerate: node scripts/mine-thai-aliases.mjs  (proposes new pairs from the latest Search Console data; a human confirms before they land here)
